title: SMTP Dial Timeout
description: The email module shall bound every outbound SMTP connection attempt with a finite dial timeout.
rationale: The current mailer uses net.Dialer with no Timeout field, so a non-responsive SMTP server blocks the dialing goroutine indefinitely; a finite dial timeout ensures the TCP connection attempt fails fast and the calling HTTP request is not held open waiting for a server that will never respond. A dial timeout of approximately 10 seconds is the target operational bound.
